what_this_is: The census's coverage check: hosts known to matter from sources OTHER than the CDP discovery list. The census script diffs its probe list against these and reports who is missing in which direction — a high-volume seller absent from the Bazaar and a Bazaar listing absent from the volume index are both findings. Every entry must name its source and date; an entry nobody can source gets removed, not defended.
how_to_fill: CV or the keeper, from a machine with network: x402scan's top hosts by settled transaction count (their leaderboard), last 30 days. One entry per host. Do not add hosts from memory or vibes — the whole point of this file is that inclusion is sourced.

seeds.note: Declared resources may be POST-method; excluded from GET probing, still counts for coverage.
